title: 'Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo' Unveils Main Cast, Additional Staff, Promo
content:
The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event unveiled the main cast, additional staff, and a cast announcement promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki 's Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ( Fall in Love, You False Angels ) manga on Saturday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Nao Ojika ( Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ) and Taito Ban ( Ore dake Level Up na Ken ) are starring the anime as Otogi Katsura and Toki Ninomae, respectively.

Yuuki Kurihara ( Haigakura ) and Yunosuke Senoo are composing the music. Kensuke Ushio ( Dandadan music) is handling the music production.

Yasutomo Okamoto ( Pluto episode director) is helming the anime at MAPPA . Youhei Yamazaki ( Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi 2 script) is handling the series composition, while Mariko Oka ( Momochi-san Chi no Ayakashi Ouji ) is designing the characters.

Uzuki began serializing the shoujo romance manga in Dessert magazine in April 2023. Kodansha published the seventh volume on June 12.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in March 2024 and released the fifth volume on June 23. The sixth volume is scheduled for release in April 2027.

title: Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising Reveals New Trailer and Third Key Visual by Ume Aoki
content:
Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Walpurgisnacht Rising revealed a new key visual and trailer. The film surpassed 1 billion yen at the Japanese box office within its first four days following its August 28 debut in Japan and is currently showing in the country

The four-day result put Walpurgisnacht Rising ahead of the initial pace of the franchise’s previous movie, Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Rebellion . Released in 2013, Rebellion ultimately earned more than 2 billion yen at the Japanese box office.

Walpurgisnacht Rising is the first new movie in the main Madoka Magica series in 13 years and serves as a continuation of Rebellion . Studio SHAFT animated the movie, with Akiyuki Shinbo as chief director and Yukihiro Miyamato as the director. You can watch the new trailer below.

A third key visual illustrated by original character designer Ume Aoki was also revealed.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica , created by the Magica Quartet (Akiyuki Shinbo, Ume Aoki, Gen Urobuchi, and producer Atsuhiro Iwakami) first premiered in January 2011. The series ran for 12 episodes, concluding in April of the same year, although the final two episodes were delayed due to the Great East Japan Earthquake. While the TV anime wrapped up the main story, the Puella Magi Madoka Magica franchise has since expanded into various media, including several manga adaptations, a novel by Nitroplus, a dedicated magazine, and video games. In October 2012, two recap films, Beginnings and Eternal , were released, which condensed the anime’s events with some new material. A third film, Rebellion , was released in October 2013, continuing the story with a fresh story that served as a prequel to Walpurgisnacht . These movies got an Ultra HD Blu-ray release on January 29, 2025.

In addition to the main series, the Magia Record spin-off story has its own anime adaptation, produced by Studio SHAFT, along with a mobile game. The new mobile game, Magia Exedra , launched on March 27, 2025 on multiple platforms (iOS, Android, and Windows).
author: Anime Corner

title: Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine Original TV Anime's New Promo Video Previews Opening, Ending Themes
content:
The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed the main promotional video for Good Smile Company 's original anime Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine). The event also revealed a new key visual and the theme song information.

Takanori Nishikawa is performing the opening theme song "Zankyō ≠ Blaster," and DayRe: is performing the ending theme song "Mikansei Ordinary" (Incomplete Ordinary).

The anime stars:

• Takuma Terashima as Gekiha Shijima

• Haruka Shiraishi as Akane Kuzumi

• Saya Aizawa as Kirei Shijima

• Nao Tōyama as Haru

• Aya Yamane as Natsu

• Misaki Kuno as Aki

• Asuna Tomari as Gō Sera

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Yūsaku Kuroiwa

• Ryōtarō Okiayu as Daigo Shijima

• Atsushi Ono as Genjūrō Shijima

• Ruriko Aoki as Yūga Shinonome

Yi Cao is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS and Kayac Animation . Toshiki Inoue (various Kamen Rider series, Death Note ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. robin is designing the characters. Majiro ( Macross Delta ) is the original character designer. An ( GOD BRAVE STUDIO ) is the mechanical designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) is the sound director.

The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

TOGUCHI is drawing a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Dengeki Daioh magazine.

The anime is the first project in Good Smile Company 's "The God of Combined Series" ("Gattaishin Series"). The anime commemorates Good Smile Company 's 25th anniversary.

title: 'Vertex Force' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The Aniplex One Focus 2026 event revealed additional cast, theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and the second promotional video for the Vertex Force original television anime on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, and Tochigi TV at 11:30 p.m. on October 3.

Voice actors Kazuki Ura ( Bungou Stray Dogs 5th Season ) and Nana Mizuki ( Dandadan ) are joining the cast as Alan and EDVA, respectively.

Japanese pop music group ClariS ( Lycoris Recoil ) is performing the opening theme "Synchro Blue". Singer Hashimero ( Witch Watch ) is performing the ending theme "Emerald". Both theme songs are previewed in the second promotional video below.

Kazuhiro Takamura ( Strike Witches ) is helming the anime at Shogakukan Music & Digital Entertainment , with Gorou Kuji ( Bungou to Alchemist: Shinpan no Haguruma ) serving as assistant director. Kazuhiro Takamura ( Vividred Operation ) and Masashi Suzuki ( Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou ) are handling the series composition. Kazuhiro Takamura ( Strike Witches ) is designing the characters, while Nobuaki Nobusawa ( Steins;Gate 0 ) is composing the music.

title: Fall in Love, You False Angels Anime Trailer Reveals Main Voice Cast
content:
Fall in Love, You False Angels anime revealed a new trailer and main voice cast ahead of its 2027 release date. It was previously confirmed that studio MAPPA would animate Coco Uzuki’s award-winning shojo manga

Nao Ojika will voice Otogi Katsura, the girl admired by everyone around her as the perfect high school beauty. Determined to maintain that flawless image at all times, Otogi carefully hides her true personality from those around her. Taito Ban will voice Toki Ninomae.

You can see the previously revealed visual below.

ALSO READ: MAPPA Shares Exciting Updates for Its Upcoming Projects, Including JUJUTSU KAISEN S4, Chainsaw Man: Assassins Arc, Special MV & More

The main staff includes:

• Director: Yasutomo Okamoto

• Character Design: Mariko Oka

• Series Composition: Yohei Yamazaki

• Art Director: Takumi Hashimoto

• Animation Production: MAPPA

This is not studio MAPPA’s first encounter with the shojo demographic. The studio was in charge of the Banana Fish TV anime in 2018. Although it’s often discussed as a crime and action series, Banana Fish was serialized in the shojo manga magazine Bessatsu Shojo Comic . In 2025, MAPPA animated the new film adaptation of The Rose of Versailles , directed by Ai Yoshimura. The film was released in Japanese theaters in January 2025 and later streamed on Netflix.

Originally launched in Kodansha’s Dessert magazine in April 2023, Fall in Love, You False Angels ( Koi Seyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ) has become one of the publisher’s most popular recent shojo titles. In 2025, it won the 49th Kodansha Manga Award in the shojo category. Kodansha USA has the manga available in English, describing the first volume: All sugar, no spice, and everything nice…that’s the impression the beautiful first-year high schooler and class president Otogi gives to those around her. One look from the school’s “heartthrob angel” is all it takes to sweep countless admirers off their feet. But the real Otogi Katsura is no angel: She’s calculating, ruthless, and sharp-tongued. When Otogi slips up and exposes her inner baddie in front of the class’s other paragon, Toki, he counters by revealing an unexpected side of his own and declaring her his “partner in crime.” With cupid’s arrow at her back, can the “heartthrob angel” maintain her perfect act and regain the upper hand, or will she be the one swept off her feet by a fellow false angel?!
author: Anime Corner

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy At All Reveals Mitsuki and Aya Character Visuals
content:
The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All anime revealed character visuals for Mitsuki and Aya ahead of the show’s January 2027 release date. The announcement was made during Aniplex’s event today. The adaptation was announced in February, while the studio and theme song were announced during Anime Expo in July..

The anime will have Nirvana’s “Breed” as the opening theme song, as revealed by Dave Grohl himself. Masashi Ishihama is directing at studio CloverWorks. The main voice cast includes Mariya Ise as Mitsuki Koga and Akari Kito as Aya Osawa. You can see the new visuals below.

The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn’t a Guy at All , often shortened to KiniOto or TGSWIIWAGAA and widely recognized by fans as the “Green Yuri” because of its recognizable green visual style, is a Japanese manga created by Sumiko Arai. The series first appeared as a short story shared on Arai’s Twitter account between July and September 2021. It later returned as a weekly web manga in April 2022 before being serialized on Pixiv Comic in April 2023. That same month, Media Factory began publishing the series in print, and as of February 2026, four collected volumes were released. In 2023, it won the Next Manga Award in the web manga category.

Crunchyroll describes the story: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya loves listening to rock, but no one else seems to share her interest…until she meets a cool, stylish employee at a CD shop. Dressed in black from head to toe, he has this air of mystery about him, and his taste in music is impeccable. Aya falls hard for him—not knowing her crush is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! For her part, Mitsuki generally keeps to herself and avoids standing out at school. But given that she sits right next to Aya, Mitsuki’s all too aware of the other girl’s feelings, and she’s afraid to reveal the truth. So why does she find herself talking with Aya more and more…?

title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers TV Anime Reveals New Opening Theme Artist, Special Promo Video
content:
The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed the new opening theme song artist for the television anime adaptation of Akira Ozaki 's Please Excuse My Younger Brothers ( Uchi no Otōto-domo ga Sumimasen ) manga. Neguse. is performing the new opening theme song "LOVE & LIKE." Aniplex is also streaming a "special promo video" for the anime.

Aniplex also revealed a video featuring four-member band Neguse. 's comment on performing the new opening theme song, and a preview of the song.

The anime debuted on July 3 on Tokyo MX , Gunma TV , Tochigi TV , and BS11 at 24:00 JST (effectively July 4 at 12 midnight JST), and will air for two consecutive cours . The anime will have a total of 24 episodes. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs.

The anime stars:

• Naomi Ōzora as Ito Narita

• Toshiki Masuda as Gen Narita

• Taku Yashiro as Raku Narita

• Kenshō Ono as Syu Narita

• Momoka Terasawa as Rui Narita

• Daisuke Ono as Isao Narita

• Aya Endō as Saho Narita

Hitoshi Nanba ( Golden Kamuy ) is directing the anime at Lay-duce . Megumi Shimizu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! ) is handling series composition. Shiori Hiraiwa ( Tomo-chan Is a Girl! ) and Yōko Fukushima ( #COMPASS2.0 ANIMATION PROJECT ) are designing the characters. Gin of Busted Rose ( Pop Team Epic ; Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members are:

• Art Design: Chie Okubo

• Prop Design: Takashi Akaishizawa

• Color Design: Tomoko Yamazaki

• Director of Photography: Naoki Ishikawa

• Editing: Gō Sadamatsu

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Sound Production: INSPION Edge

DISH// performs the current opening theme song "Aikotoba" and Reira Ushio performs the current ending theme song "Clover."

The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.

Ozaki debuted the manga in Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine in January 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 15th compiled book volume on June 25.

The manga inspired a live-action film adaptation that opened in Japan in December 2024. The film debuted at #4 in its opening weekend.

title: Vertex Force Original Anime Reveals Theme Song Artists, More Cast in 2nd Promo Video
content:
The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a second promotional video and the theme song artists for Vertex Force , an original television anime from Strike Witches and Vividred Operation director Kazuhiro Takamura . ClariS will perform the opening theme song "Synchro Blue," and Hashimero will perform the ending theme song "Emerald." The below video previews both songs.

The event also revealed two more cast members: Kazuki Ura as Alan and Nana Mizuki as EDVA.

The anime will debut on October 3 at 11:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV , and will stream on U-NEXT and other services in Japan.

The anime stars:

• Makoto Koichi as Akira Todo

• Kaede Hondo as Haruka Todo

• Ami Koshimizu as Eleanor Northbrook

• Megumi Han as Lala Zudenstein

• Rie Takahashi as Yoko Nishina

In the anime's story, Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world.

Kazuhiro Takamura is directing the anime at SMDE , and is also designing the characters. Gorō Kuji ( Chained Soldier , Peleliu: Guernica of Paradise ) is the assistant director. Kanetake Ebikawa ( Mobile Suit Gundam 00 , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury mechanical design) is the "engine designer" and JNTHED ( Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury , 2022 Urusei Yatsura mechanical design) is in charge of "ENIA design." Takamura is also overseeing the series scripts alongside Masashi Suzuki ( Lord of Vermilion: The Crimson King ; Jack-of-All-Trades, Party of None ). Masahito Onoda ( Brave Witches , Strike Witches: Road to Berlin ) is the chief animation director, and Nobuaki Nobusawa ( Clevatess , Astra Lost in Space ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• CG Director: Hiroyuki Tadokoro

• Modeling Director: Zhang Peng Jian

• Color Design: Mineyo Ōnishi

• Art Director: Ryōka Kinoshita

• Art Setting: Toshiki Amata

• Director of Photography: Masahiko Yagi

• Editing: Akinori Mishima

• Sound Director: Tomohiro Yoshida

• Sound Production: dugout

Takamura gave a message about the anime when it was first announced, stating he likes cute girls, cool mecha, and anime, and this original anime crams in everything he likes.

In the anime's story, Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world.

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 3 Anime Casts Kaede Hondo, Reveals Climax Promo Video
content:
The staff for Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 3: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke , the new television anime of Miya Kazuki 's Ascendance of a Bookworm ( Honzuki no Gekokujō - Shisho ni Naru Tame niwa Shudan o Erandeiramasen ) light novel series, announced on Saturday that Kaede Hondo will join the cast as the character Charlotte. The anime's website revealed a climax promotional video for the anime.

The anime premiered on April 4 on the Yomiuri TV and NTV channels at 5:30 p.m. JST (4:30 a.m. EDT). The anime is airing across two consecutive cours for a half-year run. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime with English subtitles and an English dub . adieu (actress Moka Kamishiraishi 's singing stage name) performs the new ending theme song for the anime's second cours (quarters of the year) titled "Wanna me." Kana Nishino performs the anime's opening theme song "Power of Love."

Yuka Iguchi and Show Hayami return in the new series as Rozemyne (previously Myne) and Ferdinand, respectively. The anime's new cast members include:

• Yukari Tamura as Georgine

• Mami Koyama as Veronica

• Minami Takayama as Florencia

• Kazuhiro Yamaji as Bonifatius

• Nao Tōyama as Angelica

• Asami Seto as Brigitte

• Katsumi Fukuhara as Zack

Yoshiaki Iwasaki ( Kowloon Generic Romance , Hayate the Combat Butler , We Never Learn: BOKUBEN ) is directing the new series at Wit Studio , replacing the franchise 's previous director Mitsuru Hongō . Mariko Kunisawa returns to write the series scripts, and Aiko Minowa ( After the Rain , The Ancient Magus' Bride in-between animation) is the new character designer. MICHIRU returns to compose the music.

Little Glee Monster performs the first part's opening theme song "Pages." Nogizaka46 member Erika Ikuta performs the first part's ending theme song "Ima mo, Arigatō" (Even Now, I Thank You).

The first anime season premiered in October 2019, and ended in December 2019 with 14 episodes. The second season premiered in Japan in April 2020. The anime's third season premiered in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed all three seasons as they aired.

Kazuki began the original novels on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in 2013, and ended the web novel in 2017. You Shiina illustrates the print edition. The main series ended with its 33rd volume (volume 12 of part 5) in December 2023. The novel series now has over 13 million copies in circulation (including digital copies).

J-Novel Club is releasing both the light novels and some of the various manga adaptations in English.

title: Fate/EXTRA Record Game Streams Character Video for Archer
content:
Aniplex revealed a new character promotional video for Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game, on Saturday during the Aniplex One Focus livestream event. The video features the character Archer, voiced by Junichi Suwabe .

The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam on January 28, following several delays. Marvelous Europe will publish the game in Europe and Australia.

The game will get a physical Limited Edition that includes a 3-disc soundtrack, SteelBook case, and artbook. The Digital Deluxe Edition will include an arranged BGM pack, Servant and player outfits bundle, three outfit packs, a digital soundtrack, and artbook.

The game was slated for a release in spring this year after a previous delay from a 2025 release. Type-Moon studio BB announced the game in July 2020, in what was the 10th anniversary of the original Fate/Extra game.

Aniplex will now publish the game.

The game had been delayed indefinitely following a mutual agreement between Notes (the Type-Moon creative circle's official corporate and publishing name) and Bandai Namco Entertainment for the latter to pull out of publishing of the game. Type-Moon noted then that development on the game would continue, but the game's development structure would change.

The game's director and planner, and Type-Moon studio BB director Kazuya Nino left Type-Moon studio BB, due to personal reasons, and has also stepped down as Fate/Extra Record game's director and planner. Nino added that he will be taking a break from developing games due to current health concerns. Nino was the producer for Fate/Extra , and also worked on the first Etrian Odyssey game.

Arco Wada returns as the game's character designer.

Marvelous Entertainment and Type-Moon released the Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game in Japan in 2010. Aksys Games released the game in North America in November 2011. The Fate/Extra CCC companion game shipped in Japan on the PSP in March 2013. The games are set in an alternate science-fiction continuity of Type-Moon 's Fate universe, often referred to by fans as the "Extraverse."

The games inspired SHAFT 's 10-episode television anime Fate/Extra Last Encore in January 2018. Netflix began streaming the anime outside of Japan in June 2018. The three-episode Fate/Extra Last Encore: Illustrias Tendōsetsu (Illustrias Geocentrism) special then debuted in July 2018.

Marvelous released Fate/EXTELLA: The Umbral Star , an "Extraverse" game, for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in November 2016. XSEED Games released the game in the West in January 2017, and on PC and Switch in July 2017. Fate/EXTELLA LINK , an enhanced version of the game, shipped in Japan in June 2018, and XSEED Games released the game in March 2019.

Koei Tecmo launched the action RPG Fate/Samurai Remnant in September 2023. The game is available worldwide for PS5, PS4, PC via Steam , and Switch.
